B.text: If the routing criterion literally requires the highest-risk state across the entire dashboard rather than only among offered eligible records, an offered record can be selected only if the chart establishes that it exceeds every other mapped state.

O.location: Rhode Island polygon, New England inset area

O.content: The visible legend is a pale-yellow-to-dark-red gradient labeled from "High"/"100" to "Low"/"0"; no gray swatch or gray label is shown.

B.text: If a state's fill color is encoded by the displayed vertical Risk Index legend, the pale-yellow end at the printed "High"/"100" end represents higher risk than the dark-red end at the printed "Low"/"0" end; fills not represented by the gradient, such as gray, have no stated risk-index value.
B.conditions: Applies only where the state fill is intended to use the displayed gradient; gray is not assigned a meaning by the visible legend.

O.content: The vertical color gradient has printed "High" at its pale-yellow top beside "100" and printed "Low" at its dark-red bottom beside "0".
The polygon labeled "DE" is filled orange-red.
The polygon labeled "NM" is filled dark burgundy-red.

O.location: Rhode Island polygon, New England inset area
O.content: The polygon labeled "RI" is filled gray.

B.text: If routing is restricted to the offered state-record options and gray/unmapped states are not eligible for a risk comparison, the offered state with the highest legend-decoded risk is the available choice most consistent with the stated highest-risk routing criterion.
B.conditions: Requires that selection is limited to the listed options and that unscored or unmapped states are excluded; it does not establish that the selected offered state is highest among all states shown.
